TermTranslation.definition: A test that uses a computer to put many x-rays together to create a 3-D picture of organs, tissues, bones and blood vessels in the body
Taking cells or tissues from the body to look at them under a microscope.

TermTranslation.term: Cystography is a procedure to visualize the urinary tract. Using a urinary catheter, radiocontrast is instilled in the bladder, and X-ray imaging is performed

Magnetic resonance imaging(MRI) scan
 test that uses a magnetic field to make very detailed pictures of the inside of the body.

TermTranslation.definition: An imaging test that uses a radioactive substance called a tracer to look for tiny deposits of cancer in the body
